title: finally back to mall world but full of people ???
content: I finally went back to the mall part of my mall world for the first time in months last night, i knew it was the same place and i was coming out of the transport hub into the side of the mall, but for the first time maybe ever it was FULL of people ?? like hundreds of people walking around in and out of shops etc, the only people i ever see in the mall part of my mall world is either people i know from real life or a few npc like shop keepers etc last night it felt so different, people were all interacting and i almost got hit by someone on a bike, in the dream i had a lucid moment of thinking wait this is my mall world again after so long and i walked up to the back of the mall to check that it was as i knew behind there would be the grassy area i always visit - and it was! but it was full of people - has anyone else experienced anything like this lately? it felt very unsettling compared to previous mall world dreams i have had
